_how: Every record and every reveal, with the tier it holds and why, from the line in docs/spec.md 'The spoiler dial'. Off holds the basics: setup, install, account and bonus codes, settings, controls, saving, performance, known problems and fixes, what is and is not in the game at launch, and one plain line of warning where a player could lose something. For a game system, Off may say only that it exists. Mild holds how a game system works in play: named in-game apps and services, prices and fees, how selling or stealing works, how police respond, how stats rise, and anything a press guide learned by playing rather than Rockstar stating it before launch. Places: where things are. Each Off record says which part of the Off list it holds (holds); one that rests on a play-guide source says why that is fine (pressGuide). Change a tier and this file together.
